$comment: Three residents (vertical slice design §3, §4-2). wake/sleep are minutes after the life day starts at my 05:00 (30 = 05:30, 1110 = 23:30, 1200 = 01:00 next morning). offWeekday: 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday. habitSleep/habitWake apply only when the village keeps that visit-band habit (§10-3, W6). home is where the resident appears at waking and leaves at sleep. multipliers are per-mille personality multipliers on the base score (§3) — they also scale the candidates a state or the weather adds, so the cafe owner never dozes; crowdedRest applies to resting at a cafe seat while customers wait. W4 (§7-1·§7-3): chores is what the resident's chores count (waiting guests, orders, observations to tidy); dozeSpot is where it dozes when tired; moods says which planner factor shows which mood line (tag = <npc>.mood.<tag>.1), and only when the chosen side, the base side and the band match its conditions (chosenKinds, chosenArchetypes, baseArchetypes, bands) — a line never says what the behaviour does not do. The planner takes the reasons in priority order and uses the first whose tag and conditions fit; none fits → the behaviour changes without a line. W5: a factor may also be a card ID (the card made its owner do its solving), a neighbour's doing (pair-glad, tea-received, with-player-glad), a card's forerunner (wobble-spotted) or the day after a night of R4 (sleepy-night, excited-find).
